changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Report') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Report]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [ObjectType] [varchar](25) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [ReportType] [varchar](25) CONSTRAINT [DF_Report_ReportType] DEFAULT ('legacy') NOT NULL, [PowerBIReportID] [varchar](50) NULL, [PowerBIDatasetID] [varchar](50) NULL, [FileName] [varchar](260) NULL, [Url] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [ShowOnHomePage] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Report_ShowOnHomePage] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Report] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: TKlok
changeSet.sql: IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Report]', 'uid') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Report ADD [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Report_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL END
changeSet.rollback: IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[Report]', 'uid') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.Report DROP COLUMN uid END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Report_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Report] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Delete', [queue].WriteIndexXml('Removed', 'Report', ID, coalesce(UpdatedBy, 0)), 'Report', ID from deleted END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Report_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Report] AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'Report', ID, coalesce(UpdatedBy, 0)), 'Report', ID from inserted END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Report_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[Report] AFTER UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Update', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'Report', ID, coalesce(UpdatedBy, 0)), 'Report', ID from inserted END
